description.value:
Trigger You roll on the Slip table.

Downgrade any Slip result you roll by one step on the table.

When you roll on the Slip table, you may take either the result you rolled or the result one row above it, your choice, seeing both first. This does not stack with Slip Ward's reroll; on a given Slip you may use either, not both.

cinderfall.incomplete: Take the rolled Slip result or one row better, seeing both first; doesn't stack with Slip Ward. Deadhand's Slip table is entirely homebrew with zero schema footprint -- there is no digital table anywhere in this corpus to have "rows," let alone a rule element that peeks at two and lets the player choose.
